title: Oxford Spiral Notebook 6 Pack, 1 Subject, College Ruled Paper, 8 x 10-1/2 Inch, Color Assortment May Vary (65007)

reviews.title: Great buy for students
reviews.body: I got the Oxford Spiral Notebook 6-Pack for school and everyday notes, and it’s honestly one of the best basic notebooks I’ve used.Right away I noticed how solid the paper quality is. The college-ruled sheets are smooth, don’t feather with gel or ballpoint pens, and hold up well even with heavy note-taking. There’s minimal bleed-through, so I can write on both sides without fear of ghosting.The size (8 x 10-1/2 inch) is great — big enough for plenty of notes but still fits nicely in a backpack or under larger books. The spiral binding feels sturdy and doesn’t snag on other stuff in my bag. Pages turn easily and lie flat when open, which makes writing comfortable.I also liked the assorted colors. It helps me separate notebooks for different subjects without needing labels.A couple of honest points:• The pack doesn’t come with dividers or pockets, so it’s strictly notebooks.• Designs vary, so if you’re after specific cover styles you might not get the exact ones shown.Overall this 6-pack delivers great quality and value for everyday use — school, work, projects, lists, and general writing. The paper feels noticeably better than cheaper pads, and the binding holds up over time.

features: A CLASSROOM CLASSIC: this 6-pack of 1-subject notebooks helps you identify your subjects at a glance with color-coding efficiency; color assortment may vary
THE RIGHT RULING: these 8" x 10-1/2", college-ruled notebooks fit more writing per page than wide-ruled sheets; each notebook provides 70 double-sided sheets with red margin lines
PERFECT PERFORATION: Dependable micro perforated sheets retain your must-have notes but still detach cleanly when you’re ready to revise
GLIDE FROM PAGE TO PAGE: Your favorite gel or ballpoint pens will move effortlessly across these smooth pages for A+ notes with minimal ink bleeding or show-through
3-HOLE PUNCHED: Every notebook comes 3-hole punched to fit a standard binder; take along one notebook or several to save extra trips to the locker
